policies.title: Gabonese ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked nationality schedule lists Gabon as requiring a visa prior to arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Gabonese passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Grenada's schedule defines Prior to Arrival as a visa obtained at a Grenada mission or consulate before travel.
The active Embassy schedule was updated April 2024 and should be rechecked if Grenada publishes a replacement.
Work, study, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Gabonese ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule places Gabon in its authorized-visa cohort for advance consular approval.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Gabonese passport holder who does not qualify for Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver.
Apply in person at the competent Panamanian consulate before travel; approval may take up to 60 business days.
Work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

application.label: Panama Embassy authorized-visa instructions
application.processingTime: Up to 60 business days, depending on document verification and completion.
steps: Determine that the separate third-country-document waiver does not apply.
Submit the required documents in person to the competent Panamanian consulate.
Travel only after the authorized visa is granted.
